title: EmoNet: A Lightweight Attention-Based CNN for Speech Emotion Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.33977v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is a fundamental task in affective computing that enables applications such as mental health assessment, human-computer interaction, and automated customer support systems. Accurate emotion classification from speech remains challenging due to variations in speaker style, acoustic conditions, and the high computational cost of modern deep learning approaches. Many existing systems depend on large transformer-based architectures that require substantial computational resources, making them less suitable for real-time or resource-constrained environments. translated_title: EmoNet：一种用于语音情感识别的轻量级基于注意力的卷积神经网络
translated_abstract: 语音情感识别（SER）是情感计算中的一项基础任务，可支持心理健康评估、人机交互和自动化客户服务系统等应用。由于说话人风格的变化、声学条件的差异以及现代深度学习方法高昂的计算成本，从语音中实现准确的情感分类仍然具有挑战性。许多现有系统依赖于需要大量计算资源的大型Transformer架构，使其不太适合实时或资源受限的环境。本研究提出了EmoNet，这是一个面向七类情感分类的轻量级深度学习框架。该模型基于四块深度可分离卷积编码器构建，融合了挤压-激励注意力和残差连接，并结合双向LSTM进行时序特征学习以及多头注意力……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该研究提出EmoNet，一种融合深度可分离卷积编码器、挤压-激励注意力、双向LSTM和多头注意力的轻量级框架，能够在资源受限环境下高效完成七类语音情感识别。
en_tdlr: This research proposes EmoNet, a lightweight deep learning framework combining a depthwise separable CNN encoder with squeeze-and-excitation attention, Bidirectional LSTM, and multi-head attention for efficient seven-class speech emotion recognition in resource-constrained environments.
